title: detection_counts_hourly
description: One row of the view public.detection_counts_hourly. detections is calling activity: the number of non-rejected detection events in that UTC hour for a node, species, and label. It is not a count of individual fish. species_id is null when the detector did not assign a species. Rejected detections are omitted. hour is the UTC hour start.

hour.description: UTC hour start from date_trunc on detections.start_time.
